entities.summary: Papyrus 103, designated by 𝔓103, is a copy of part of the New Testament in Greek. It is a papyrus manuscript of the Gospel of Matthew. Papyrus 103 is a manuscript. Classified as Tier A (Primary Source) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
